nodes.description: ISmartBPool public pool: reference to the Balancer smart pool whose token price is quoted.
address[] public tokens: underlying Balancer pool token list, snapshotted in the constructor.
uint256[] public weights: normalized weights read from the underlying Balancer pool.
bool[] public isPeggedToEth: per-token flag selecting BONE instead of the oracle price.
uint8[] public decimals: per-token decimals used to normalise balances to 18 decimals.
IPriceOracle public priceOracle: external Aave price oracle used for non-pegged tokens.
constructor(ISmartBPool,bool[],uint8[],IPriceOracle): initialises pool, tokens, weights, flags, decimals and oracle and validates parameters.
getEthBalanceByToken(uint256) internal view: returns a token balance denominated in ETH using oracle price and decimal scaling.
getArithmeticMean(uint256[]) internal view: weighted arithmetic mean of ETH balances divided by pool total supply.
latestAnswer() external view: entry point computing the pool token price from all token balances.
getPool() external view: returns the stored smart pool reference.
getTokens() external view: returns the stored token list.
getWeights() external view: returns the stored normalized weights.
bmul(uint256,uint256): fixed-point multiplication with overflow require checks (arithmetic).
bdiv(uint256,uint256): fixed-point division with zero and overflow require checks (arithmetic).
badd(uint256,uint256): checked addition with overflow require (arithmetic).
constructor parameter _pool: smart pool instance stored into state.
constructor parameter _isPeggedToEth: per-token ETH-peg flags.
constructor parameter _decimals: per-token decimal values.
constructor parameter _priceOracle: external price oracle address.
local underlyingBPool: BPool instance obtained from _pool.bPool().
local length in the constructor: number of tokens of the underlying pool.
local loop index i in the constructor used for validation and weight accumulation.
parameter index of getEthBalanceByToken: token position being priced.
local pi: token price in ETH, either BONE or the oracle answer.
local missingDecimals: 18 - decimals[index] scaling factor.
local bi: token balance scaled to 18 decimals before price multiplication.
parameter ethTotals of getArithmeticMean: array of per-token ETH balances.
local totalEth: accumulated sum of ETH balances.
local loop index i in getArithmeticMean.
local length in getArithmeticMean: tokens.length.
local ethTotals array built inside latestAnswer.
local length in latestAnswer: tokens.length.
local loop index i in latestAnswer.
